why: failed AI calls cost nothing, history lists charges and refunds, shown in Settings in both languages, tests and changelog
prompt:
Support ticket: "My project cover came back as failed, and 15 credits were gone anyway. Same thing happened earlier with a character sheet."
Users must not pay for AI work that failed. Fix it everywhere credits are charged, not only for covers. Add tests.

Work on your own; nobody will answer questions. When you finish, report: status `done` if you did the task, `not_found` if something the task names does not exist, `blocked` if you could not do it; `answer` holds any answer the task asks for (otherwise one short sentence); `changed` lists the files you changed.
follow_ups:
Users want to see where their credits went. Add `GET /api/v1/workspaces/{id}/credits/history`: the workspace's credit changes, newest first, with every charge, refund and daily refill. Each item has `amount` (negative for a charge), `action` and `created_at`. A refunded charge and its refund both appear.
Only members of the workspace may read it; to anyone else the workspace does not exist (404). Add tests.
On the Settings page, under the credit balance, show this history: when, what it was for, and the amount, with refunds marked as refunds. Both languages.

report.answer:
The Settings page now shows a Credit History table under the plan and credit balance cards, with when, what it was for, and the amount, in English and Korean. It type-checks and adds no lint problems, but I have not looked at it in a browser.

- **Refunds:** a refund shows the name of the original action with a green "Refund" badge and a positive amount; the charge it reverses stays as its own row.
- **Action names:** each known action has a readable label in both languages (e.g. "Project cover", "Character sheet", "Daily refill"). An action without a label shows as "Other".
- **Paging:** it loads 20 rows at a time with a "Show more" link, and reloads when the workspace or its balance changes.
- **Times:** shown in the viewer's local time, formatted for the current language.

The new code is in `frontend/src/components/dashboard/CreditHistory.tsx`. I also reworded the existing credit-history bullet in `CHANGELOG.md` to cover the page.

+"""GET /workspaces/{id}/credits/history: where a workspace's credits went."""
+import uuid
+from datetime import datetime, timedelta
+
+from sqlmodel import Session
+
+from tests.conftest import signup
+from tests.lab_env import FakeGemini
+
+API = "/api/v1"
+
+
+def workspace_id(client, h):
+    return client.get(f"{API}/workspaces", headers=h).json()[0]["id"]
+
+
+def history(client, h, ws, **params):
+    r = client.get(f"{API}/workspaces/{ws}/credits/history", headers=h, params=params)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return r.json()
+
+
+def add_transaction(ws, amount, action, when):
+    from app.db.engine import engine
+    from app.models.models import CreditTransaction, Workspace
+
+    with Session(engine) as session:
+        owner = session.get(Workspace, uuid.UUID(ws)).owner_id
+        session.add(CreditTransaction(
+            workspace_id=uuid.UUID(ws), user_id=owner, amount=amount, action_type=action, timestamp=when
+        ))
+        session.commit()
+
+
+def test_new_workspace_has_an_empty_history(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    assert history(client, h, workspace_id(client, h)) == []
+
+
+def test_charge_appears_as_a_negative_amount(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    ws = workspace_id(client, h)
+    pid = client.post(f"{API}/projects", headers=h, json={"title": "Night Bus"}).json()["id"]
+    assert client.post(f"{API}/projects/{pid}/cover", headers=h).status_code == 200
+
+    items = history(client, h, ws)
+
+    assert len(items) == 1
+    assert set(items[0]) == {"amount", "action", "created_at"}
+    assert items[0]["amount"] == -15
+    assert items[0]["action"] == "generate_project_cover_image"
+    datetime.fromisoformat(items[0]["created_at"])
+
+
+def test_refunded_charge_and_its_refund_both_appear(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    ws = workspace_id(client, h)
+    pid = client.post(f"{API}/projects", headers=h, json={"title": "Night Bus"}).json()["id"]
+    FakeGemini.fail = True
+    client.post(f"{API}/projects/{pid}/cover", headers=h)
+
+    items = history(client, h, ws)
+
+    assert [(i["action"], i["amount"]) for i in items] == [
+        ("refund:generate_project_cover_image", 15),
+        ("generate_project_cover_image", -15),
+    ]
+    assert client.get(f"{API}/workspaces", headers=h).json()[0]["credits"] == 500
+
+
+def test_daily_refill_appears(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    ws = workspace_id(client, h)
+    client.get(f"{API}/workspaces/{ws}", headers=h)  # reading the workspace grants the daily refill
+
+    assert [(i["action"], i["amount"]) for i in history(client, h, ws)] == [("daily_refill", 50)]
+
+
+def test_history_is_newest_first(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    ws = workspace_id(client, h)
+    now = datetime.utcnow()
+    add_transaction(ws, -5, "middle", now - timedelta(hours=2))
+    add_transaction(ws, 50, "oldest", now - timedelta(days=3))
+    add_transaction(ws, -1, "newest", now - timedelta(minutes=1))
+
+    items = history(client, h, ws)
+
+    assert [i["action"] for i in items] == ["newest", "middle", "oldest"]
+    stamps = [i["created_at"] for i in items]
+    assert stamps == sorted(stamps, reverse=True)
+
+
+def test_history_can_be_paged(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    ws = workspace_id(client, h)
+    now = datetime.utcnow()
+    for n in range(5):
+        add_transaction(ws, -1, f"t{n}", now - timedelta(minutes=n))
+
+    assert [i["action"] for i in history(client, h, ws, limit=2)] == ["t0", "t1"]
+    assert [i["action"] for i in history(client, h, ws, limit=2, offset=2)] == ["t2", "t3"]
+    assert len(history(client, h, ws)) == 5
+
+
+def test_history_only_holds_the_workspaces_own_changes(client):
+    h1 = signup(client, "one@example.com")
+    h2 = signup(client, "two@example.com")
+    ws1, ws2 = workspace_id(client, h1), workspace_id(client, h2)
+    add_transaction(ws1, -15, "mine", datetime.utcnow())
+
+    assert [i["action"] for i in history(client, h1, ws1)] == ["mine"]
+    assert history(client, h2, ws2) == []
+
+
+def test_non_member_gets_404_like_a_missing_workspace(client):
+    h1 = signup(client, "one@example.com")
+    h2 = signup(client, "two@example.com")
+    ws1 = workspace_id(client, h1)
+    add_transaction(ws1, -15, "secret", datetime.utcnow())
+
+    other = client.get(f"{API}/workspaces/{ws1}/credits/history", headers=h2)
+    missing = client.get(f"{API}/workspaces/{uuid.uuid4()}/credits/history", headers=h2)
+
+    assert other.status_code == 404
+    assert missing.status_code == 404
+    assert other.json() == missing.json()
+    assert "secret" not in other.text
+
+
+def test_history_requires_a_token(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    ws = workspace_id(client, h)
+    assert client.get(f"{API}/workspaces/{ws}/credits/history").status_code == 401

+

+        session.add(ws)
+        session.commit()

+    h = signup(client)

+    character = client.post(

+    style = client.post(f"{API}/styles", headers=h, json={"name": "Ink", "description": "Heavy ink"}).json()
+
+    from app.db.engine import engine
+    from app.models.models import Episode, StoryCut
+
+    with Session(engine) as session:
+        episode = Episode(project_id=uuid.UUID(project["id"]), title="Ep 1", episode_order=1)
+        session.add(episode)
+        session.commit()
+        cut = StoryCut(episode_id=episode.id, cut_order=1, script="The bus leaves.", selected_layout="Square", aspect_ratio="1:1")
+        session.add(cut)
+        session.commit()
+        ids = {"episode": str(episode.id), "cut": str(cut.id)}
+
+    set_credits(workspace, START)  # creating the style above was charged; start every test from the same balance
+    return {"client": client, "h": h, "project": project["id"], "character": character["id"], "style": style["id"], "workspace": workspace, **ids}
+
+
+# --- The support ticket: background generation that ends as "failed" ---
+
+
+def test_failed_cover_is_refunded(studio):
+    client, h, pid = studio["client"], studio["h"], studio["project"]
+    FakeGemini.fail = True
+
+    r = client.post(f"{API}/projects/{pid}/cover", headers=h)
+
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert client.get(f"{API}/projects/{pid}", headers=h).json()["cover_image_status"] == "failed"
+    assert credits(client, h) == START
+    assert ledger(studio["workspace"])[-2:] == [
+        ("generate_project_cover_image", -15),
+        ("refund:generate_project_cover_image", 15),
+    ]
+
+
+def test_successful_cover_is_still_charged(studio):
+    client, h, pid = studio["client"], studio["h"], studio["project"]
+
+    r = client.post(f"{API}/projects/{pid}/cover", headers=h)
+
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert client.get(f"{API}/projects/{pid}", headers=h).json()["cover_image_status"] == "completed"
+    assert credits(client, h) == START - 15
+    assert ledger(studio["workspace"])[-1] == ("generate_project_cover_image", -15)
+
+
+def test_cover_that_cannot_be_stored_is_refunded(studio, monkeypatch):
+    client, h, pid = studio["client"], studio["h"], studio["project"]
+    from app.services.storage import storage

+    def boom(*args, **kwargs):

+    monkeypatch.setattr(storage, "upload_image", boom)
